messages:
marta: Heads up — planning a blue->green traffic shift for router v1.12.0 tonight 22:00 UTC. Plan: canary 5% 10m → 50% 10m → 100%. Need per-customer pin for two enterprise customers and rollback thresholds. @ryan can you confirm pin list? @sre-oncall please prep rollback playbook. Quiet window 21:50–22:10.

deploy-bot: Release created: router v1.12.0 (rel-2024-11-03-22). Canary policy: 5/10/50/100. Scheduled start: 2024-11-03T22:00:00Z. Steps: warm pools, run smoke, shift weights. Run `/deploy status rel-2024-11-03-22` to follow.

ryan: Confirmed — pin list: acme-inc, globex-enterprises. I'll add per-route pin for /api/enterprise -> v1.11 until 02:00 UTC. Leaving note in customer-configs repo. :white_check_mark:

sre-oncall: Rollback thresholds (draft):
- error-rate > 2% absolute or > 3x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes
- p95 latency spike > 300ms over baseline for 5 minutes
- SLO alerts firing for more than two buckets
If triggered: 1) set router weights back to green=0 old=100, 2) drain new pool, 3) page infra oncall.
Snippet to cut traffic quickly:
```
# cut all traffic to old
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $ROUTER_API" \
  https://router-admin.internal/weight-swap \
  -d '{"from":"green","to":"blue","percent":100}'
```
I'll attach a short runbook to the incident channel and pre-bake rollback run.

jess: I'll push a short release note for eng+support with the customer pins and the quiet window. Also adding a 'what to watch' checklist.

infra-deploy: We'll pre-warm caches at 21:30 UTC and run smoke tests against the green pool (health, kv cache hit, auth). Expect ~7m. We'll also hold a 5m handoff channel at 21:50. Recommend disabling non-critical background jobs during the 22:00–22:20 window.

marta: SGTM. Final preflight at 21:30 in this thread. If anything changes ping @infra-deploy directly. :thumbsup:
